hypotheses.E1_dictionary_span: A ridge projection onto all SAE decoded-write vectors reaches at least 0.95 residual and downstream fidelity.
hypotheses.E2_encoder_coefficient_failure: Refitting coefficients on the encoder-selected changed support improves downstream fidelity over the observed full code by at least 0.20.
hypotheses.E3_oracle_compactness: A per-site correlation-selected 32-feature support with refit coefficients reaches at least 0.70 downstream fidelity.
hypotheses.E4_fixed_membership: The frozen category-specific 32-feature support with refit coefficients reaches at least 0.50 downstream fidelity.
hypotheses.E5_category_specificity: The own-category fixed support exceeds the wrong-category support by at least 0.15 downstream fidelity after both receive optimal coefficients.
